Vaishnavi Desai
Senior Digital Marketing Leader | Mumbai
vaishnavi.desai718@example.com | +91 9895943676

Seasoned digital marketing professional with a track record of driving acquisition and retention across B2C and B2B channels. Combines data-driven campaign optimization with creative channel strategies to increase ROI and scale high-performing funnels. Experienced in leading cross-functional teams and implementing analytics-driven improvements.

Experience

- Implemented GA4 reporting dashboards and automated weekly alerts, improving campaign response time and enabling a 15% uplift in incremental conversions through rapid bid and creative adjustments.
- Led A/B tests across search and social creatives, using Google Ads audience segmentation to increase click-through rate by 22% and lower CPA for strategic enterprise offers.
- Coordinated with engineering via Jira to deploy tracking fixes and tag implementations on Linux-hosted landing pages, improving data quality and reducing attribution discrepancies.

Tata Consultancy Services — Jan 2015 - Sep 2024
Performance Marketer
- Managed multinational Google Ads accounts and Social Media Marketing programs, driving a 35% year-over-year increase in qualified leads for cloud and software services through refined targeting and bidding strategies.
- Migrated legacy Universal Analytics setups to GA4, rebuilding event schemas and dashboards which improved lead-tracking accuracy by 40% and informed budget reallocation decisions.
- Executed SEO initiatives combined with paid search, resulting in a 50% improvement in organic landing page traffic and a 20% reduction in paid spend for high-intent queries.
- Used Jira to coordinate campaign launches with product and analytics teams, and validated tag deployments on Linux servers to ensure consistent data capture across regions.

Performance Marketer

- Implemented on-page SEO optimizations and content strategies that boosted organic search visibility for key categories, leading to a 30% rise in organic registrations.
- Ran targeted paid social experiments tied to email re-engagement campaigns, improving win-back rates by 12% and contributing to overall revenue lift.
- Coordinated with engineering and analytics to instrument tracking for campaigns, validating events on Linux-based staging environments.

Projects
- Cross-Channel Attribution Model: Built a GA4-based attribution model prototype combining Google Ads, Social Media Marketing, and Email Marketing touchpoints to guide budget allocation; prototype influenced Q1 channel budgets and improved ROAS by 18% in pilot segments.
- Automated Campaign Health Monitor: Created Jira-driven workflow and scripts to alert on campaign anomalies (spend spikes, tracking failures) across Google Ads and social platforms, reducing time-to-detection by 60%.
